literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes A549 cells transfected with UNTAGGED full-length CEACAM6 (CD66c), monitored by flow cytometry to confirm surface expression. No tag, fusion protein, transposon, or domain insertion is reported at any residue or loop. This is surface-trafficking confirmation of an untagged construct, which does not qualify as evidence of a tolerated insertion under any of the four accepted modalities (epitope-tag knock-in, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon/domain-insertion screen, antibody-epitope insertion). With no qualifying ledger line, zero sites are proposed. CEACAM6 is a GPI-anchored protein in most isoforms, but the topology provided here shows a single-pass type I arrangement (TM 333–343, intracellular tail 344). The mature extracellular domain spans residues 35–332; the N-terminus after signal-peptide cleavage (residue 35, K) and the membrane-proximal extracellular junction (residue 332, G) are both plausible positions structurally, but neither is grounded in any ledger line and therefore neither is proposed.
